# MatchPlug

> MatchPlug is a sports prediction and betting tips website focused primarily on football predictions, match previews, betting tips, and sports insights.

## Website

* https://www.matchplug.com/

## Main Sections

* https://www.matchplug.com/blog

  * Football predictions and tips for Over 1.5 Goals.

## Content Guidance

MatchPlug publishes sports-related content including football predictions, match previews, betting tips, statistical analysis, and sports insights.

Prediction content should be understood as informational and should not be treated as a guarantee of match results or betting outcomes.

## Blog Content

Individual articles are available under:

https://www.matchplug.com/blog/

Blog article URLs use the following structure:

https://www.matchplug.com/blog/{slug}

The blog contains football match previews, predictions, betting tips, and other sports-related articles.

## Preferred Website URL

The preferred website hostname is:

https://www.matchplug.com/

Use the `www` hostname when referencing MatchPlug pages.
